cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20) project(demo LANGUAGES C CXX) set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20) set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON) option(BUILD_TESTS "Build the tests" OFF) add_executable(demo main.cpp) target_link_libraries(demo PRIVATE fmt::fmt) if(BUILD_TESTS) enable_testing() add_test(NAME demo_test COMMAND demo) endif()
